description: High-level validation setup/execution flows mapped to deterministic adapter actions. The script only renders or executes these registered actions; it does not generate new runtime logic.

pa_recover.description: Enable and persist PA when audio playback succeeds but the DUT does not wake.

power_on.description: Power on DUT through configured control serial port.

power_off.description: Power off DUT through configured control serial port.

switch_device_env.description: Send the project device environment command on AP before cloud/API operations.

ensure_online.description: Ensure local hotspot is up and DUT can reconnect.

wake_audio_file.description: Play one wake or command audio file through the configured playback device.

wake_audio_repeat.description: Repeat one wake or command audio file through the configured playback device.

set_half_duplex.description: Set half-duplex mode through cloud API.

set_full_duplex.description: Set full-duplex mode through cloud API.

set_volume.description: Set device volume through cloud API.

set_night_mode.description: Set night mode through cloud API.

proactive_interaction.description: Trigger long TTS/self-play media through cloud API for interrupt tests.
